description: Elections Commission - Notice under section 10 A (1)(a) Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: The gazette content is a formal notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that a member of a Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party.
